scenarios.what: The sources sheet opened during the guided tour, then Esc
scenarios.expected: Esc closes the sheet first and leaves the tour where it stands

scenarios.what: A formation selected, the sources sheet opened, then Esc
scenarios.expected: Esc closes the sheet and keeps the selection

scenarios.what: The sources sheet (aria-modal) by click: where focus goes, Tab, then the close button
scenarios.expected: focus moves into the modal sheet, stays there, and returns to Sources on closing (as the ? overlay does)

scenarios.what: Space while the sources sheet is open (focus not on a button)
scenarios.expected: a modal sheet: Space does not play the clock behind it

scenarios.what: The opening's stretch playing, "?", Esc, Esc
scenarios.expected: ? over the playing opening, Esc closes it, Esc ends the opening at 04:00, ½×, focus on Play

scenarios.what: The opening's stretch playing, then the key M (the ground)
scenarios.expected: ended in place: clock stopped, ½× back, the paper map, focus on a visible element

scenarios.what: The opening at step 2, then the key 3 (Clean), then Esc
scenarios.expected: 3 ends the opening in place in Clean; Esc then shows everything

scenarios.what: The eye level at Napoleon's headquarters, then Begin the opening from the tools
scenarios.expected: the opening leaves the eye level (its stop's camera is above the floor)

scenarios.what: The layers panel by click, then Esc: focus returned
scenarios.expected: Esc closes the panel and returns focus to its button

scenarios.what: Play from 17:58 to the day's end, then Play again
scenarios.expected: stops at 18:00; Play again starts the day from 04:00

scenarios.what: The opening playing at 1600 x 900, the window narrowed to 1024 x 768 (undocked), then Skip
scenarios.expected: Skip after the resize: the end state

scenarios.what: The guided tour at stop 3, then Begin the opening from the tools
scenarios.expected: the opening replaces the tour; Skip leaves neither

scenarios.what: The key 2 (Watch) with the card open, then Esc
scenarios.expected: 2 closes the card and switches to Watch; Esc back to Study

scenarios.what: Play from 05:30; the dwell turned off in the Layers panel, 10 s of play, then on again
scenarios.expected: the clock never goes back when the dwell is turned on again (it was 382.4)

scenarios.what: Study at 1280 x 800, the card closed, the window narrowed to 1000 x 800; then 2 and Esc
scenarios.expected: below 1080 px the rail never stands over the dispatch card (after the resize, and after 2 then Esc)

scenarios.what: A formation's dossier: a real click on its close button, then Tab
scenarios.expected: after the dossier closes, focus is never on an off-screen control

scenarios.what: The eye level at Napoleon's headquarters, then a real click on a phase on the timeline
scenarios.expected: a phase's camera leaves the eye level (not the eye pinned with Follow on)

scenarios.what: The "?" overlay, a click on its heading (not focusable), then Esc
scenarios.expected: Esc closes the overlay wherever the click left focus

scenarios.what: Visual effects off and on (F, F), four times: the GPU textures counted
scenarios.expected: textures after four off-on toggles not above the count before (31)

scenarios.what: The mouse wheel over the map while the first-run card is open
scenarios.expected: anything done outside the card closes it (the wheel too)

scenarios.what: The Layers panel opened in Study, then the key 2 (Watch)
scenarios.expected: the panel closes with its opener hidden in Watch

scenarios.what: Whose eyes: the Allied headquarters, on the paper map at 05:00: which French counters are drawn, and the leaves' readings
scenarios.expected: no enemy corps counter drawn whose every formation the reading does not know

scenarios.what: prefers-reduced-motion switched on after load (emulated), then Begin and Next
scenarios.expected: a preference changed after load is honoured (Next cuts, no stretch)
